name: rfc8032-7-1
description: Ed25519 keypair pinned to RFC 8032 §7.1 Test 1. Shared across the A2A-IDF conformance suite, the Envoys signature/v1 spec §13 reproducible vectors, and the aps-conformance-suite composition fixtures so verifiers can demonstrate byte-match parity across implementations.
warning: These keys are published in RFC 8032 itself and are for cross-implementation verification only. They MUST NOT be used to sign anything in any production deployment.

crossReferences.name: envoys-signature-v1
crossReferences.use: Composes A2A-IDF identity-framework wrap over Envoys wire signatures using this keypair.
